content: {"argument": "The regex change adjusts the TLD length limit from `{2,63}` to `{1,62}`, reflecting RFC standards where labels are limited to 63 characters and the minimum TLD length is 1 (though no single-character TLDs currently exist). The test uses a 63-character suffix after the dot, which exceeds the new limit of 62, so the regex does not match and www. is not stripped — this is correct behavior under the updated constraint. The test assumes a 63-character suffix is valid for stripping www., but the change intentionally tightens the validation to align with hostname label limits.", "concedes": false}
